wordmark.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent CAMID wordmark texture for the user's actual 3D product.
Input reference: the user's own camera rendering. Look specifically at the CAMID mark on the graphite rectangular side panel. Reconstruct ONLY that exact existing wordmark in a clean flat orthographic view, removing the perspective imposed by the camera surface.
Exact text: "CAMID" (C A M I D), uppercase, precisely five characters.
Letter style: faithfully match the reference's heavy condensed technical block letters, squared/softly chamfered corners, thick strokes, compact spacing and narrow inner cutouts. The C, A, M, I and D must read unmistakably. This is a restoration of the provided branding, not a new logo proposal. The current website's thin generic CAMID font is wrong; match the heavy compact original reference.
Output: a single horizontal wordmark centered, taking up most of a wide 3:1 canvas, strictly flat solid deep muted dark crimson ink (#70252a), transparent background, crisp edges, no lighting, no shadows, no perspective, no embossing, no outlines. Keep transparent inner counters of letters. No panel, no camera, no extra symbols, no slogan, no other text, no border, no white rectangle, no watermark.
The printed color is quiet burgundy, not luminous or saturated bright red. Final application scales this artwork onto a CAD side panel.

fascia.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a FLAT ORTHOGRAPHIC BASE-COLOR TEXTURE for the upper rectangular film-outlet housing of the CAMID B1 camera, not a photo of a camera.
Create a landscape 5:2 aspect ratio texture artwork, edge-to-edge, front-facing flat rectangle. Reference image supplies only its charcoal graphite / muted burgundy material palette. No perspective, no scene, no camera parts.
Surface design: very dark charcoal polymer outer border around a broad slightly lighter graphite inset surface. Border 5 percent on each side. Crisp precision rounded rectangular inset boundary, tiny radius, nearly flush, not embossed. Fine restrained evenly distributed matte micrograin in the inset, subtly directional fine satin grain on a narrow strip along the bottom. Main face must retain generous quiet negative space, luxury instrument rather than a busy graphic.
Typography: near the lower left inside the inset, a very small understated medium-dark grey "B1" product code, about 6 percent of total texture height. To its right, smaller widely tracked exact text "MECHANICAL CAMERA". Keep both low contrast and elegant. No invented specs or serial numbers. A thin short muted burgundy accent rule near the lower right aligned with the baseline. All graphics planar flush printed ink, no fake shadows or raised typography.
Colors: outer charcoal around sRGB #25272a, main graphite around #34373b, bottom satin strip around #292b2f, typography #64656a, accent #70252a. Uniform neutral ambient color only, no lighting gradient, no reflections, no shadows, no highlights, no 3D bevel, no vignette.
Constraints: no CAMID logo on this texture (main brand is on a different side panel), no lens, no lens circle, no bolts, no mechanical seams, no cutouts, no GUI, no watermark. Entire canvas opaque. Actual product geometry will be supplied by CAD.
